OFFICE ORDER

With a view of affectively monitor the progress of each of the Regional
Office /Sub-Regional Office in relation to the data entry being made in the Legal
Dashboard, The field offices are equally divided between Shri M.P. Varghese,
ACC(Legal) and Shri A.K. Gupta, Director, NATRSS/ACC as per the details annexed
herewith.

The above officers are advised to monitor the progress with regard to the
data entry of the court cases, filing of counter reply and updation of data in the
Legal Dashboard on regular basis. They are also advised to put up the progress
report through the undersigned to CPFC on fortnightly basis, first report be put up
on 04/01/2016.
